source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Take a photo of the label, plug, or cord reel plug.
3. Close off the first section of the test record with the appliance/cord details.
4. Close off the second section of the test record with a list of all tests performed, observations, results, and comments. Keep it short and clear.
5. Close off the third section of the test record with a visual assessment of the appliance or cord, documenting all defects and damages on the appliance, cord, label, or plug (take photos of all marked-up items on the appliance from various angles).
